fronts.why: Winter Storm Fern, 01-24 -23.8F; 202(c) orders, Transmission Emergency 01-25
03-16 -24.4F with Freeze Warnings, +10.6F rebound 03-18; hub RT max $221
Independence Day storm complex: 24 severe-thunderstorm warnings 07-04..06 (18 on 07-05), heat dips -0.8F and -1.2F
Tropical Storm Warning on the upper Texas coast 07-23 ends the July heat wave (90.6F and Extreme Heat Warnings 07-22, then -1.9F and -3.1F)
Extreme Heat Warning for North Texas in force 08-17..22, 13 heat advisories, daily mean 88.9-89.4F; hub RT max $154 08-18
08-26 scarcity (hub RT max $795, mean $120, 17 ERCOT notices), then 15 severe-thunderstorm warnings 08-27..28 and -2.2F 08-28 as the August heat breaks

ci.method: block bootstrap, the pack's weather fronts as blocks, task-weighted means; a split's CI draws its own fronts; post − pre draws each split's fronts apart

lead_rule.text: The pre-registered rule that the post-cutoff half leads if the halves differ guards against training-data contamination, so, as read before any API-model result, only a model whose reported training cutoff comes after the first pre-cutoff window (Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Luna) can trigger it, when its post − pre interval in C excludes zero.

text.halves: Every model scores lower on Jul–Aug than on Jan–May, and that includes Qwen3-4B, whose training predates every window. So the drop reflects harder windows (the Jan–May half includes winter storm Fern), not evidence of training-data contamination. No API model's post − pre interval excludes zero, so all 32 windows lead, by a rule set before any API result.
text.rule: The pre-registered rule that the post-cutoff half leads if the halves differ guards against training-data contamination, so, as read before any API-model result, only a model whose reported training cutoff comes after the first pre-cutoff window (Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Luna) can trigger it, when its post − pre interval in C excludes zero.
text.valid: Qwen3-4B made no valid submission on 7 of its 32 windows (R = 0 there).
text.reliability: 216 attempts for 128 model-windows; 88 did not reach the grade (infrastructure ×88). Infrastructure failures were retried; attempts that failed before any model call (a port race in our launcher, $0) didn't count toward the two-retry limit (see Deviations). No window is missing.
text.metered: Interrupted attempts are costed from the proxy meter, because their last turn never reaches the trajectory.
